description: This PHP class, ClaimAttachmentDecorator, serves as a decorator for the ClaimAttachment entity within the OrangeHRM platform. It provides methods to access and manipulate claim attachment data, including retrieving the attachment content as a string and associating a user by user ID. The class uses traits for authentication and ORM helper functionalities, and encapsulates a ClaimAttachment object.

classes.name: ClaimAttachmentDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class for ClaimAttachment entity providing additional functionalities such as setting related user and retrieving attachment content.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the decorator with a ClaimAttachment entity.

methods.name: setUserByUserId
methods.description: Associates a User entity with the ClaimAttachment based on the provided user ID.

methods.name: getAttachment
methods.description: Retrieves the attachment data as a string, reading it from the underlying ClaimAttachment if not already loaded.
